training_design: All 56 registered isolated stay-vs-move intentions on 14 pre-exposed maps, including the unpaid intentions. No parameter selection; 01-07 results were already published or seen. Each terrain has equal total weight. Signed pay-minus-defer official margin, no clipping. Use the five frozen public cost/area/tenure/cover/freight features plus three physical features, comparing adjacent hostile collectors, adjacent hostile planters, and whether the present target is an existing enemy tree. Grouping and labels are offline only.
comparison: Frozen v1 and equal-map train-only intercept, same support bounds and departure threshold. Score all selected opportunities in supplemental intake 08; seal decisions for the entire selection with both seats before any response score is loaded. Retain sign and magnitude for every focal action; report no-op, misses and actual purchases separately as diagnostics with denominator. Report mean by terrain, each physical seat, terrain directional agreement, realized loss if wrong. No root is a new game win. No promotion to a full match on this two-map comparison. No new simulation or new maps consumed by this experiment.
